# SMEasy

> Simple staff rostering for Australian small businesses — cafés, restaurants, bars, shops and other small teams. Free for up to 6 staff, and a flat $29/month + GST (Plus) for unlimited staff. In open beta. No per-user fees.

## What SMEasy does
- Managers log in with email and password, or with an emailed login link.
- Build a weekly roster: tap a day to add a shift with start, finish, unpaid break and role. Split shifts and shifts past midnight are supported.
- Copy last week's roster in one tap.
- Shifts are colour-coded by role; shifts and days can carry notes; shifts can be left unfilled ("no one yet"); a daily cover line shows people on, hours and gaps.
- Australian public holidays are marked by state.
- Staff can subscribe to their published shifts in Apple, Google or Outlook calendars from their personal link.
- See paid hours per person and for the team. Each person has usual weekly hours (default 38); the roster quietly notes when someone is rostered above them. SMEasy works out hours, not pay: no wage estimates or pay rates.
- Day view: a calendar-style day (hours down the page) with gaps in cover shown in red; the week grid shows a gap bar under each day.
- The week can start on any day (Settings).
- Timesheets (Hours tab): confirm or adjust the hours actually worked, mark no-shows, approve the week.
- Xero Payroll sync: connect Xero, match staff to Xero employees, and send approved hours as draft timesheets in each employee's pay period.
- Publish when ready; drafts stay private.
- Share with staff via one team roster link (for the staff group chat), a printable A4 PDF, or email: on publish, each rostered person with an email gets their shifts. Staff need no app, account or password, and see only names, days, times and roles.
- Staff request time off from a personal link; managers approve or decline on the roster.
- Download hours as a CSV, shift by shift with rostered and worked hours and per-person totals, for MYOB or a bookkeeper.
- Plans: Free for up to 6 staff; Plus $29/month or $290/year + GST for unlimited staff; Pro $49/month or $490/year + GST adds payroll sync. During the beta, timesheets are free on every plan; Xero sync is Pro only (coming soon).
- Data is stored in Australia (Sydney).

## What SMEasy does not do (yet)
- No SMS or phone push notifications (email only).
- No in-app shift swaps.
- No award interpretation, penalty-rate calculation or payroll processing.
- No MYOB sync yet (CSV for now).
- One manager login and one location per business.
